name: Corrosive Touch
body:
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 213
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level arcanist 1, bloodrager 1, magus 1, sorcerer 1, summoner 1, summoner (unchained) 1, wizard 1
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes
Description
Your successful melee touch attack deals 1d4 points of acid damage per caster level (maximum 5d4).
